title: Authenticated Creator Handle Claim
summary: Provide a dedicated authenticated one-time creator handle claim operation backed by the canonical Sesh creator handle reservation repository.
invariants: The authenticated canonical PrincipalId must resolve through the explicit PrincipalId to SeshCreatorId mapping before any handle claim.
Client input supplies only a requested handle; creator identity is never client supplied.
The requested handle is canonicalized through normalizeSeshCreatorHandle using NFKC, trim, lowercase, and the locked Sesh handle grammar.
A creator may own at most one canonical handle reservation.
A normalized handle may belong to at most one creator.
Claiming the same canonical handle again by the same creator is idempotent.
Claiming a different handle after a creator already owns one returns conflict.
Claiming a handle owned by a different creator returns conflict.
The reservation row is the canonical handle ownership record.
The operation does not write SeshCreatorProfile.handle because the D1 abstraction provides no transaction primitive spanning reservation and profile persistence.
No release or change operation is exposed by this service.
A creator handle reservation grants no project ownership, collaborator, publishing, management, legal, copyright, CRM, or account rights.
deferred: profile read overlay from canonical reservation
